name: ADX Smooth
description: This keyword returns the value of the smooth Average Directional Index of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the value of the smooth Average Directional Index of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632226345.png)

You can fetch the  smooth Average Directional Index  on any candle of an instrument, like in the above example, you can fetch the  smooth Average Directional Index  of previous (-1) day candle of Nifty 50 spot
